# MYP5 Italian Literature - Identity and Voice

Class: MYP5 Italian B
Date: 2026-08-04
Unit: Poetry and personal narrative

Learning goal: Students compare how poets use imagery and repetition to develop voice, then draft a short personal response in Italian.

Warm-up: Students annotate two short stanzas and mark one image that connects to identity.

Main activity: In pairs, students discuss the speaker's point of view and prepare a three-sentence explanation using evidence from the poem.

Differentiation notes: Marco Bianchi benefits from a two-step visual checklist before writing. Nora Rossi can extend the task by adding a second quotation and explaining nuance.

Exit ticket: Students submit one claim, one quotation, and one reflection on how language shapes identity.
